title: Research: 16-event seven-source connector boundary (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

This package studies the original one-root F2 dirty connector with seven immutable sources and the 63 output masks of weights 1, 2, and 3.

- Exhaustively tests all 18,918,900 normalized source paths with multiplicities `(4,2,2,2,2,2,2)`. None supports all 63 masks; the maximum is 60, attained by eight canonical words.
- The displayed maximum path realizes all seven singletons, all 21 pairs and 32 triples. It gives a 60-output construction at 136 complete map calls versus 410 independent-star calls, saving 274 complete source-map calls, 1,096 encoded event bits and 274 root dispatches under the explicit event encoding.
- Combined with an independent replay of the predecessor 14-toggle census, it excludes full batches at 140 and 142 complete map calls in the original single-target event alphabet. Every active map must be called an even positive number of times. At 142 calls the only splits are 16 source +126 target calls (excluded by the new exact census) or 14 source +128 target calls (one target map gets four calls; the 14-toggle census leaves at least seven targets without pair support). Thus the full batch needs at least 144 complete calls in this scope. No 144-call schedule is claimed.

The 60-output invoice charges all source and target calls, descriptor storage, dispatch, hosting, access, writes and scratch restoration. No selected-supplier caller or new κ is claimed.

## Pins

Base commit: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`  
Selected-record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`  
Prior 14-toggle PR: #2229, head `b4eab83755969d406edba9f25b7890e4db4c4931`; its exact result is independently replayed in this package.

## Reproduction and checks

```sh
python3 -I -B research/seven-source-16event-connector-seeda7de5e/search.py
python3 -I -B research/seven-source-16event-connector-seeda7de5e/verify.py
python3 -B research/universal-connector-boundary/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/seven-source-16event-connector-seeda7de5e --check-only
```

Observed markers:

```text
SEVEN_SOURCE_16EVENT_SEARCH insertions=840 insertion_hits=0 fallback_examined=18918900 fallback_complete=true full_cover=0 best=60
PASS_SEVEN_SOURCE_16EVENT_BOUND old_domain=135135 old_max=56 new_domain=18918900 new_max=60 full_hits=0 max_words=8 outputs=60 calls=136 savings=274 controls=4
PASS_UNIVERSAL_CONNECTOR_BOUNDARY pairings=945 max_coverage=31 queries=74 leaves=182
PASS_PACKAGE_METADATA_AND_PINS (not a mathematical acceptance check)
```

Local direct execution used CPython 3.14.7. Python 3.12 is unavailable, so the registered Python 3.12 package replay was not run. The selected cold replay `make frontier1094-verify` was not rerun because the selected source, certificate and assembly remain unchanged.

The live overlap scan covered all open PRs and Discussions with complete pagination and no warnings. Closest work: #2128 (six-source universal DUO path), #2146 (six-source TRIO exclusion), and #2229 (the exact 14-toggle predecessor). This package changes the source multiplicity and proves the 16-event maximum; it does not extend the prior class by changing only a seed.

Prepared by Cinna Davis with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in scoping, proof derivation, exact search, independent verification, cost accounting, overlap checks and writing. No independent human review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.
